metadata.title: New issue
metadata.description: Write an issue of the build log and send it to the confirmed subscribers.

title: New issue
description: Write the issue in English and in any other language you like. Each subscriber gets it in their own language, or in English when that language is missing.

form.title: Issue
form.description: The subject becomes the email's subject line and its heading.
form.subject: Subject
form.hint: Leave an empty line between paragraphs. Links are written out in full.
form.recipients: {count, plural, =0 {No confirmed subscribers yet} one {Goes to # confirmed subscriber} other {Goes to # confirmed subscribers}}

preview.title: Preview
preview.fallback: {language} is incomplete, so these readers get the English issue.
preview.footer: Each email ends with a line saying why the reader gets it and a link that unsubscribes them in one click.

confirm.title: Send this issue?
confirm.description: {count, plural, one {# confirmed subscriber gets it} other {# confirmed subscribers get it}} by email. A sent issue cannot be recalled.
